newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela CANTV Nov 22 offer, $3.25 per share - paper. [CORRECTED 17:11 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Venezuela CANTV Nov 22 offer, $3.25 per share - paper. [CORRECTED 17:11 GMT]

text.p: The global share offering of the Venezuelan government's 40 percent share in telephone company CANTV will open on November 22 at an estimated price of $3.25 per share, local financial daily Economia Hoy reported.
The base price will be fixed on November 21, the Wall Street offering will begin on November 22 and, locally, shares will begin to trade on November 26, the paper said.
Four hundred million Class D shares will be offered in total, of which some ten percent will be placed on the Caracas stock exchange.
Local representatives of investment bank SBC Warburg, which is leading the global offering with Lehman Brothers, were not immediately available for comment.

According to the paper small local investors will be offered first stab at the shares between November 4 and 19, at a three to five percent discount. Thereafter, larger local investors will be able to place orders. Local trading begins November 26 -- four days after the Wall Street offering.
A national advertising campaign is to begin this Sunday, the paper said.
